#!/bin/bash
source /tmp/diff.sh

# --- help / usage ---
run_case help --help
run_case help-h -h
run_case help-abbrev --he
run_case help-abbrev2 --h
run_case help-twice -h -h
run_case help-with-a --a 1 -h
run_case short-bundle -hfoo
run_case help-eq --help=x

# --- argparse errors ---
run_case noargs
run_case unknown-opt --a 1 --b 2
run_case missing-val --a
run_case dashdash-val --a -- 5
run_case dashdash-lead -- --a 1
run_case dashdash-trail --a 1 --
run_case extra --a 1 extra
run_case ambiguous --=1
run_case short-a -a 1
run_case upper-A --A 1
run_case a1 --a1 1
run_case unknown-short --a 1 -x
run_case a-help-val --a --help
run_case only-neg -3
run_case dashdash-x2 --a -- -- 5
run_case val-then-dd --a 5 -- 7

# --- int() failures, incl. repr escaping ---
run_case empty --a ""
run_case bad-token --a 1,x
run_case float --a 1.0
run_case hex --a 0x10
run_case eq-empty --a=
run_case single-quote --a "'"
run_case both-quotes --a "\"'"
run_case ctrl-1f --a "$(printf '\x1f5')"
run_case zwsp --a "$(printf '​5')"
run_case backslash --a 'a\b'
run_case emoji --a "$(printf '\U0001F600')"
run_case soft-hyphen --a "$(printf '­')"
run_case tab-inside --a "$(printf 'x\ty')"
run_case del-char --a "$(printf '\x7f')"
run_case dbl-underscore --a 1__0
run_case lead-underscore --a _1
run_case trail-underscore --a 1_
run_case sign-underscore --a +_1
run_case sign-space --a "- 1"
run_case ws-only --a "  "
run_case double-comma --a 1,,2
run_case unicode-minus --a "$(printf '−3')"
run_case superscript --a "$(printf '²')"
run_case nd-lookalike --a "$(printf 'ᵿ')6"

# --- whitespace that int() *does* strip ---
run_case nbsp-strip --a "$(printf ' 5')"
run_case u3000-strip --a "$(printf '　5')"
run_case x85-strip --a "$(printf '5')"
run_case u2028-strip --a "$(printf ' 5')"
run_case u1680-strip --a "$(printf ' 5')"
run_case vtab-strip --a "$(printf '\v5\f')"

report
